tei:bibl.tei:title: עַל הַנִּסִּים ביום שחרור השבויים כ״א בְּתִשְׁרֵי תשפ״ו תשרי
Al Hanissim for the Day of Hostage Release upon the Two Year Anniversary of October 7 by Rabbi Cantor Hillary Chorny (Temple Beth Am, Los Angeles)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Hillary Chorny
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: This al hanissim for the day of the release of the remaining living hostages taken by HAMA”S to Gaza on 7 October 2023, was offered by Rabbi Cantor Hillary Chorny (Temple Beth Am, Los Angeles) on 13 October 2025, on Hoshana Rabba 5786. The text of the prayer was first published in a Google Doc with a link shared over social media, with permission to share with attribution.
